freeze_rule: Machine-enforced: contracts.FrozenCoreGate re-hashes every source listed in frozen_sources_sha256 against the live tree at each model-touch attempt and refuses any scoring-package module this mapping does not name. Editing a frozen source therefore re-closes the gate at the next touch; a new scoring version requires regenerating this artifact and e0-closure.json, never an in-place edit.

semantics.entity: multiset precision/recall/F1 over normalized entity strings
semantics.known_limits_v1: casefold expands Turkish dotted I (U+0130) into 'i'+combining dot, which rule 5 then splits ('İstanbul' -> 'i stanbul'), and strips combining marks from precomposed Greek; both apply symmetrically to reference and hypothesis. Entity PRF is corpus-level multiset counting: an item with no expected and no predicted entities contributes nothing (f1 of an all-empty comparison is 0.0, never used per-item). WER alignment is O(len(ref)*len(hyp)) and is frozen for per-segment scoring, not whole-call alignment.
semantics.normalization: NFKC + casefold; apostrophe variants -> ASCII; dashes and non-alphanumerics -> space; only intra-word apostrophes survive; whitespace collapsed; no number expansion (v1)
semantics.qa: SQuAD-style best-over-answers exact match and token F1
semantics.transitions: correct-to-wrong / wrong-to-correct at token level (ASR, via hit masks) and item level (QA/entity, via boolean flags)
semantics.wer: unit-cost Levenshtein over normalized tokens; deterministic backtrace preference match/substitution > deletion > insertion; per-reference-token hit mask is the transition substrate
